description.zh: 资源分组名。如何获取资源分组名，请参见[ListResources](~~449143~~)。
description.en: The name of the resource group. You can call [ListResources](~~449143~~) to obtain the name of the resource group.

description.zh:
Label过滤条件集合，多个条件用逗号分隔。只有同时满足这些标签的资源才会被返回。

目前只有ProductType=ACS的资源才支持用该参数过滤。
description.en:
Tag-based filter conditions. Multiple conditions are separated by commas (,). Only resources that meet all the specified tag-based filter conditions are returned.

This parameter is available only for resources whose ProductType is ACS.

description.zh:
选项，取值如下：

- ListResourceByWorkspace（默认值）：获取工作空间的资源列表。
- ListResource：获取用户的资源列表。
description.en:
The operation to perform. Valid values:

*   ListResourceByWorkspace: obtains the resources in the workspace. This is the default value.
*   ListResource: obtains the resources of the user.

description.zh: 资源列表的页码，起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. The pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，默认为20。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20.

description.zh: **该字段已废弃，将会下线，请使用ResourceType字段。**
description.en: **This field is no longer used and will be removed. Use the ResourceType field instead.

description.zh:
QuotaId集合，用逗号分割。只有同时具有这些QuotaId的资源才会被返回。


> 目前只有ResourceTypes=ACS的资源才支持用该参数过滤。
>
description.en:
The quota IDs, which are separated by commas (,). Only resources that contain all the specified quotas are returned.

>  This parameter is available only for resources whose ResourceTypes is ACS.

description.zh:
资源名。格式为：
- 长度为3~28个字符。
- 同地域内唯一。
description.en:
The resource name. The value must meet the following requirements:

*   The name must be 3 to 28 characters in length.
*   The name is unique in the region.

description.zh:
资源类型列表。取值如下：

- MaxCompute：大数据计算服务资源
- ECS：通用计算资源
- Lingjun：灵骏智算资源
- ACS：ACS计算资源
- FLINK：Flink资源
description.en:
The resource types. Valid values:

*   MaxCompute
*   ECS
*   Lingjun
*   ACS
*   FLINK

description.zh:
是否展示详细信息，目前详细信息包含字段Quotas。取值如下：
- true（默认值）：展示详细信息
- false：不展示详细信息
description.en:
Specifies whether to show detailed information, which includes the Quotas field. Valid values:

*   true (default)
*   false

description.zh:
逗号分隔的集合，表明要返回的字段。目前支持：
- Quota
- Label
- IsDefault
description.en:
The fields to return. Multiple fields are separated by commas (,). Valid values:

*   Quota
*   Label
*   IsDefault

description.zh:
工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
- 当参数Option为ListResourceByWorkspace时，该参数必填。
- 当参数Option为ListResource时，该参数无需配置。
description.en:
The workspace ID. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.

*   This parameter is required when the Option parameter is set to ListResourceByWorkspace.
*   You do not need to configure this parameter when the Option parameter is set to ListResource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace list-resources --workspace-id 123 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --product-types MaxCompute --group-name group --resource-name resource --option ListResourceByWorkspace --verbose true --resource-types MaxCompute --quota-ids quota-k000000da,quota-cd000000w --labels system.supported.dsw=true,system.supported.dlc=true --verbose-fields Quota,IsDefault --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/resources --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName group --ProductTypes MaxCompute --ResourceTypes MaxCompute --QuotaIds 'quota-k000000da,quota-cd000000w' --PageSize 20 --Verbose true --PageNumber 1 --ResourceName resource --WorkspaceId 123 --VerboseFields 'Quota,IsDefault' --Option ListResourceByWorkspace --Labels 'system.supported.dsw=true,system.supported.dlc=true' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
